base_prompt: Create a production game sprite: ONE isolated solid opaque PURPLE sphere, straight-on orthographic view, perfect circular silhouette centered in a square transparent canvas, sphere diameter 82% of image. Use the attached red-ball reference ONLY for its material and light/shadow character, NOT the red color and NOT the cup or pile. Translate that reference into rich amethyst purple body, muted lilac light-facing area, deep plum/cool violet shadows. Match the reference's substantial solid ball: smooth satin luster with ONE restrained, soft-edged compact highlight at upper left (10 o'clock), broad form shading over the upper-left hemisphere and rich deep lower-right shadow. The diffuse body color remains saturated over most of the sphere; do not wash it out. Strong rounded volume even at 65px display diameter. The highlight is softly colored pale lilac, not a bright white sticker or a rectangular studio softbox; no multiple reflected windows. Opaque smooth surface, no clearcoat film, no glass, no translucency, no refraction, no glow, no luminous rim, no hard dark outline, no noise or texture, no cast shadow outside the silhouette. No cup, no ground, no text, no other spheres. Alpha 1 inside the sphere; genuinely transparent outside with clean antialiased boundary. The lower-right surface should be dark saturated purple, not black. Render as refined realistic 2.5D game art.
variant_prompt: Edit the attached single-sphere game sprite. Change ONLY its pigment/color palette to {color}. Preserve exactly the opaque satin material, restrained soft highlight at upper left, highlight size and softness, continuous strong rounded shading, silhouette, scale and transparent background. Keep most of the sphere rich in its body color. The highlight may be gently lighter and less saturated than the body but must not become a white reflective sticker. No transparent resin, no clearcoat film, no glass, no luminous rim, no secondary highlights, no ground shadow, no noise, no cup, no text. Return ONE centered perfect circular sphere on genuinely transparent background; fully opaque interior. This is a matching sprite in a four-color set.
